title: 第六十九章压迫感第六十八章顾长风
slug: 扫地八十年从宗门杂役飞升成仙
lines: 正殿内的空气黏稠得像要凝固，那盏黄豆大的孤灯散着惨白的光晕，将高台上顾长风的影子无限拉长。
叶凡的指尖死死抵在袖口的储物袋上，体内的赤红灵气早已被他用《九龙搬血》的法门死死锁在骨髓最深处。
四转锻体五阶的强悍肉身此刻呈现出一种病态的紧绷，他连呼吸都拉得极长，生怕一丝多余的波动引来这位元婴大能的探查。
顾长风那句质问在大殿里荡出层层回音，震得叶凡耳膜生疼。
“晚辈愚钝，不明长老所指。”
叶凡把头埋得更低，声音里恰到好处地带上了一抹惊恐与颤抖。
这种散修和底层杂役面对高阶修士时该有的本能反应，被他演得毫无破绽。
“常人受了马得水等人的围攻，不死也得脱层皮。”
“你一个锻体境，身中数道术法，气血却隐而不发，反而越发旺盛，你真当本座这双眼睛是摆设？”
顾长风从高台的阴影中缓步走下，鞋底踏在青石板上，发出沉闷的声响。
每走近一步，叶凡就感觉压在肩膀上的重量翻了一倍，浑身的骨头都开始发出细微的酸胀感。
叶凡脑子里电光石火般闪过无数个借口，最终还是咬定牙关。
“晚辈前些日在废丹洞当差，误食了一颗不知名的红果，侥幸活了下来。”
“自那以后，体内气血就变得比常人粗重些，但修为却跌到了锻体境，”
“至今未能彻底炼化那股药力。晚辈不敢欺瞒长老。”
这个借口他曾对马得水和那个神秘的凝气期青年说过，真真假假混在一起，最难分辨。
顾长风在距离叶凡十步远的地方停下了脚步。
这位执法堂首座的面容在灯光下显得极为古朴，宛如一尊没有情感的石雕。
他并没有像叶凡预想中那样直接伸手掐住他的脖子搜魂，也没有用庞大的神识强行撕开他的气海。
“红果？”
顾长风嘴角扯动了一下，分不清是冷笑还是讥讽。
“罢了，宗门之内，谁没点机缘隐秘。只要不是魔功，本座懒得深究。”
听到这句话，叶凡藏在袖子里的手掌微微松开了一些，掌心全是冷汗。
他赌对了，元婴期大能何等高傲，怎么可能真的为了一个外门弟子的奇遇去翻箱倒柜。
只要不是魔道之物，在他们眼里，低阶修士的秘密和路边的石子没什么区别。
顾长风转过身，缓步走向大殿一侧的太师椅，撩开袍子坐了下来。
他伸手拨弄着旁边几案上的茶盏，陶瓷碰撞的清脆声音在空旷的正殿里显得格外刺耳。
“带上来的那个黑木盒，本座看了。”
顾长风端起茶杯，轻轻抿了一口，语气平静得像是在谈论今天的天气。
“劣质的血线草，掺了灵兽的败血，用凡火劣灶烧出来的碎渣。”
“马得水那蠢货，连栽赃的把戏都做不明白。”
“这种脏东西，甚至不配落在执法堂的正殿地砖上。”
叶凡心里微微一沉，没有接话。
他原本准备了一肚子关于如何自证清白、如何反驳马得水陷害的辩词，现在看来，全成了废话。
在绝对的实力和地位面前，对错早就一清二楚，顾长风一眼就看穿了这场闹剧的本质。
“既然长老明鉴，那马管事擅闯民居、构陷同门之罪……”
叶凡试探着开口。
“马得水自然有水牢等着他。”
顾长风打断了叶凡的话，将茶盏放回几案，发出一声轻响。
“但你，今晚本不该站在这个地方。”
大殿内的温度似乎随着这句话又降了几分。
叶凡眉头微皱，有些不解地看着高台上的老人。

The air in the main hall was so thick that it seemed to be solidifying. The solitary lamp as big as a soybean exuded a pale halo, stretching the shadow of Gu Changfeng on the high platform infinitely.
Ye Fan's fingertips were firmly pressed against the storage bag on his cuffs, and the red spiritual energy in his body had long been locked in the deepest part of his bone marrow using the "Nine Dragons Moving Blood" method.
The powerful body of the fifth level of fourth-turn forging was showing a kind of morbid tightness at this moment. He even breathed extremely long, for fear that any unnecessary fluctuation would attract the exploration of the powerful Nascent Soul.
Gu Changfeng's question reverberated in the hall, making Ye Fan's eardrums hurt.
"Juniors are stupid and don't know what the elders are referring to."
Ye Fan buried his head lower, his voice just right with a hint of panic and trembling.
This kind of instinctive reaction that casual cultivators and low-level handymen should have when facing high-level cultivators was played by him flawlessly.
"Ordinary people are besieged by Ma Deshui and others, and they will have to shed their skin even if they don't die."
"You are in the body-building realm, and you have a lot of spells in your body, but your energy and blood are not released, but are getting stronger and stronger. Do you really think that these eyes of mine are just for decoration?"
Gu Changfeng walked slowly down from the shadow of the high platform, the soles of his shoes making a dull sound on the bluestone.
With every step he took, Ye Fan felt that the weight on his shoulders doubled, and all the bones in his body began to feel slightly sore.
Countless excuses flashed through Ye Fan's mind, but he finally gritted his teeth.
"This junior was on duty in the Feidan Cave a few days ago. He accidentally ate an unknown red fruit and survived by luck."
"Since then, the qi and blood in the body have become thicker than ordinary people, but the cultivation level has dropped to the body-forging realm,"
"So far, I have not been able to completely refine the medicinal power. The younger generation dare not deceive the elders."
He had told Ma Deshui and the mysterious young man in the Qi Condensation Stage about this excuse. It was the most difficult to tell the difference between true and false when they were mixed together.
Gu Changfeng stopped ten steps away from Ye Fan.
The face of the head of the law enforcement hall looked extremely simple under the light, like a stone sculpture without emotion.
He did not directly reach out and pinch his neck to search for his soul as Ye Fan expected, nor did he use his huge spiritual consciousness to forcefully tear open his sea of ​​​​qi.
"Hongguo?"
The corner of Gu Changfeng's mouth twitched, and he couldn't tell whether it was a sneer or a sarcasm.
"That's all, no one in the sect has any chance to keep secrets. As long as it's not magic power, I don't bother to dig into it."
After hearing these words, Ye Fan's palms hidden in his sleeves relaxed slightly, and his palms were covered with cold sweat.
He was right in his bet. How could a Nascent Soul Stage master be so arrogant and arrogant that he could really rummage through boxes and cabinets just for the adventure of an outer disciple.
As long as it is not a demonic thing, in their eyes, the secrets of low-level monks are no different from the stones on the roadside.
Gu Changfeng turned around, walked slowly towards the Grand Master's chair on the side of the hall, lifted up his robe and sat down.
He stretched out his hand to fiddle with the tea cups on the tables next to him. The crisp sound of ceramics clashing was particularly harsh in the empty main hall.
"I have taken a look at the black wooden box you brought up."
Gu Changfeng picked up the tea cup and took a sip. His tone was as calm as if he was talking about today's weather.
"Inferior blood thread grass, mixed with the septic blood of spiritual beasts, and the residue burned with ordinary fire and inferior stoves."
"That idiot Ma Deshui can't even understand how to frame someone up."
"This kind of dirty stuff doesn't even deserve to be on the floor tiles of the main hall of the Law Enforcement Hall."
Ye Fan's heart sank slightly and he didn't answer.
He originally prepared a lot of arguments about how to prove his innocence and how to refute Ma Deshui's frame-up, but now it seems that it is all nonsense.
In the face of absolute strength and status, right and wrong have long been clear. Gu Changfeng saw through the essence of this farce at a glance.
"Since the elders have learned clearly, then Steward Ma is guilty of breaking into a residence and framing a fellow sect member..."
Ye Fan tentatively spoke.
"Ma Deshui naturally has a water prison waiting for him."
Gu Changfeng interrupted Ye Fan and put the tea cup back on the table with a soft sound.
"But you shouldn't be standing in this place tonight."
The temperature in the hall seemed to drop a bit with these words.
Ye Fan frowned slightly and looked at the old man on the high platform with some confusion.
